limitations: Original captured CBOR files remain unchanged; transaction and reference-carrier changes are deliberate in-memory mutations.
Original signatures and integrity commitments are not recomputed; these transactions are not admission fixtures.
The positive V4 control is synthetic execution evidence only. It does not establish full native Dijkstra validation, Dolos submission or on-chain acceptance.
Upstream V4 and subtransaction support is preserved, not implemented by this regression-only rebased commit.
The archived parameter source is a Dolos response, not an independent consensus replay. Unknown historical node version and current spendability remain unknown.
